grok.rationale: The slice states that 50% working interests in defined acreage crossed to the partners while operatorship was contractually allocated by phase (partner operates drilling/completion; Swift assumes operations at production), so the conveyed product interest and processes were aligned at closing rather than mismatched (gap_45=0). openai.rationale: The customer-facing acreage interests transferred fractionally, while operations were coherently allocated by phase: the partner operated Eagle Ford drilling and completion, and Swift resumed operatorship when wells entered production.
